_comment: 27 raw findings from a pattern-based scanner over the sample fleet. Mirrors the AppSec Santa audit shape: 8 standard MCP instructions + 10 mitigated designed features + 3 false positives collapse to 6 genuine concerns (27 -> 6, ~78% noise).
